audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Leviticus / Vayiqra priestly ordination narrative text tradition, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for ordination of Aaron and sons, washing, garments, anointing, sin/purification offering, burnt offering, ordination ram, blood on ear/thumb/toe, seven-day entrance command.

verses.restored: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

modern.text: Then the LORD said to Moses,

original.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר

verses.restored: Take Aaron and his sons with him, and garments, anointing oil, bull of sin/misalignment offering, two rams, and basket of unleavened bread.

familiar.text: Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments, and the anointing oil, and a bullock for the sin offering, and two rams, and a basket of unleavened bread;

modern.text: “Take Aaron and his sons, their garments, the anointing oil, the bull of the sin offering, the two rams, and the basket of unleavened bread,

original.text: קַ֤ח אֶֽת אַהֲרֹן֙ וְאֶת בָּנָ֣יו אִתּ֔וֹ וְאֵת֙ הַבְּגָדִ֔ים וְאֵ֖ת שֶׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֑ה וְאֵ֣ת פַּ֣ר הַֽחַטָּ֗את וְאֵת֙ שְׁנֵ֣י הָֽאֵילִ֔ים וְאֵ֖ת סַ֥ל הַמַּצּֽוֹת

verses.restored: And assemble all congregation at entrance of tent of meeting.

familiar.text: And gather thou all the congregation together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

modern.text: and assemble the whole congregation at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.”

original.text: וְאֵ֥ת כָּל הָעֵדָ֖ה הַקְהֵ֑ל אֶל פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד

verses.restored: Moses did as YHWH commanded him, and congregation assembled at entrance of tent of meeting.

familiar.text: And Moses did as the LORD commanded him; and the assembly was gathered together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

modern.text: So Moses did as the LORD had commanded him, and the assembly gathered at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

original.text: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ מֹשֶׁ֔ה כַּֽאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֹת֑וֹ וַתִּקָּהֵל֙ הָֽעֵדָ֔ה אֶל פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד

verses.restored: Moses said to congregation, This is the matter that YHWH commanded to be done.

familiar.text: And Moses said unto the congregation, This is the thing which the LORD commanded to be done.

modern.text: And Moses said to them, “This is what the LORD has commanded to be done.”

original.text: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶל הָעֵדָ֑ה זֶ֣ה הַדָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה לַעֲשֽׂוֹת

verses.restored: Moses brought Aaron and his sons near and washed them with water.

familiar.text: And Moses brought Aaron and his sons, and washed them with water.

modern.text: Then Moses presented Aaron and his sons and washed them with water.

original.text: וַיַּקְרֵ֣ב מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶֽת אַהֲרֹ֖ן וְאֶת בָּנָ֑יו וַיִּרְחַ֥ץ אֹתָ֖ם בַּמָּֽיִם

verses.restored: He put tunic on him, girded him with sash, clothed him with robe, put ephod upon him, girded him with woven band of ephod, and bound it to him with it.

familiar.text: And he put upon him the coat, and girded him with the girdle, and clothed him with the robe, and put the ephod upon him, and he girded him with the curious girdle of the ephod, and bound it unto him therewith.

modern.text: He put the tunic on Aaron, tied the sash around him, clothed him with the robe, and put the ephod on him. He tied the woven band of the ephod around him and fastened it to him.

original.text: וַיִּתֵּ֨ן עָלָ֜יו אֶת הַכֻּתֹּ֗נֶת וַיַּחְגֹּ֤ר אֹתוֹ֙ בָּֽאַבְנֵ֔ט וַיַּלְבֵּ֤שׁ אֹתוֹ֙ אֶֽת הַמְּעִ֔יל וַיִּתֵּ֥ן עָלָ֖יו אֶת הָאֵפֹ֑ד וַיַּחְגֹּ֣ר אֹת֗וֹ בְּחֵ֨שֶׁב֙ הָֽאֵפֹ֔ד וַיֶּאְפֹּ֥ד ל֖וֹ בּֽוֹ

verses.restored: He placed breastpiece upon him, and put into breastpiece the Urim and Thummim.

familiar.text: And he put the breastplate upon him: also he put in the breastplate the Urim and the Thummim.

modern.text: Then he put the breastpiece on him and placed the Urim and Thummim in the breastpiece.

original.text: וַיָּ֥שֶׂם עָלָ֖יו אֶת הַחֹ֑שֶׁן וַיִּתֵּן֙ אֶל הַחֹ֔שֶׁן אֶת הָאוּרִ֖ים וְאֶת הַתֻּמִּֽים

verses.restored: He set turban on his head, and on turban at front he set gold plate, holy crown, as YHWH commanded Moses.

familiar.text: And he put the mitre upon his head; also upon the mitre, even upon his forefront, did he put the golden plate, the holy crown; as the LORD commanded Moses.

modern.text: Moses also put the turban on Aaron’s head and set the gold plate, the holy diadem, on the front of the turban, as the LORD had commanded him.

original.text: וַיָּ֥שֶׂם אֶת הַמִּצְנֶ֖פֶת עַל רֹאשׁ֑וֹ וַיָּ֨שֶׂם עַֽל הַמִּצְנֶ֜פֶת אֶל מ֣וּל פָּנָ֗יו אֵ֣ת צִ֤יץ הַזָּהָב֙ נֵ֣זֶר הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה

verses.restored: Moses took anointing oil and anointed dwelling-place and all that was in it, and sanctified them.

familiar.text: And Moses took the anointing oil, and anointed the tabernacle and all that was therein, and sanctified them.

modern.text: Next, Moses took the anointing oil and anointed the tabernacle and everything in it; and so he consecrated them.

original.text: וַיִּקַּ֤ח מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶת שֶׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֔ה וַיִּמְשַׁ֥ח אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן וְאֶת כָּל אֲשֶׁר בּ֑וֹ וַיְקַדֵּ֖שׁ אֹתָֽם

verses.restored: He sprinkled from it on altar seven times, anointed altar and all its vessels, basin and its stand, to sanctify them.

familiar.text: And he sprinkled thereof upon the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and all his vessels, both the laver and his foot, to sanctify them.

modern.text: He sprinkled some of the oil on the altar seven times, anointing the altar and all its utensils, and the basin with its stand, to consecrate them.

original.text: וַיַּ֥ז מִמֶּ֛נּוּ עַל הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ שֶׁ֣בַע פְּעָמִ֑ים וַיִּמְשַׁ֨ח אֶת הַמִּזְבֵּ֜חַ וְאֶת כָּל כֵּלָ֗יו וְאֶת הַכִּיֹּ֛ר וְאֶת כַּנּ֖וֹ לְקַדְּשָֽׁם

verses.restored: He poured from anointing oil on Aaron's head and anointed him, to sanctify him.

familiar.text: And he poured of the anointing oil upon Aaron’s head, and anointed him, to sanctify him.

modern.text: He also poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron’s head and anointed him to consecrate him.

original.text: וַיִּצֹק֙ מִשֶּׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֔ה עַ֖ל רֹ֣אשׁ אַהֲרֹ֑ן וַיִּמְשַׁ֥ח אֹת֖וֹ לְקַדְּשֽׁוֹ

verses.restored: Moses brought Aaron's sons near, clothed them with tunics, girded them with sashes, and bound caps on them, as YHWH commanded Moses.

familiar.text: And Moses brought Aaron’s sons, and put coats upon them, and girded them with girdles, and put bonnets upon them; as the LORD commanded Moses.

modern.text: Then Moses presented Aaron’s sons, put tunics on them, wrapped sashes around them, and tied headbands on them, just as the LORD had commanded him. The Priests’ Sin Offering

original.text: וַיַּקְרֵ֨ב מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶת בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֗ן וַיַּלְבִּשֵׁ֤ם כֻּתֳּנֹת֙ וַיַּחְגֹּ֤ר אֹתָם֙ אַבְנֵ֔ט וַיַּחֲבֹ֥שׁ לָהֶ֖ם מִגְבָּע֑וֹת כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה

verses.restored: He brought near bull of sin/misalignment offering, and Aaron and his sons laid hands on head of bull of sin/misalignment offering.

familiar.text: And he brought the bullock for the sin offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the bullock for the sin offering.

modern.text: Moses then brought the bull near for the sin offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head.

original.text: וַיַּגֵּ֕שׁ אֵ֖ת פַּ֣ר הַֽחַטָּ֑את וַיִּסְמֹ֨ךְ אַהֲרֹ֤ן וּבָנָיו֙ אֶת יְדֵיהֶ֔ם עַל רֹ֖אשׁ פַּ֥ר הַֽחַטָּֽאת

verses.restored: He slaughtered it, and Moses took blood/life, put it on horns of altar all around with his finger, and purified/cleansed altar; he poured blood/life at base of altar and sanctified it, to make atonement/covering upon it.

familiar.text: And he slew it; and Moses took the blood, and put it upon the horns of the altar round about with his finger, and purified the altar, and poured the blood at the bottom of the altar, and sanctified it, to make reconciliation upon it.

modern.text: Moses slaughtered the bull, took some of the blood, and applied it with his finger to all four horns of the altar, purifying the altar. He poured out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar and consecrated it so that atonement could be made on it.

original.text: וַיִּשְׁחָ֗ט וַיִּקַּ֨ח מֹשֶׁ֤ה אֶת הַדָּם֙ וַ֠יִּתֵּן עַל קַרְנ֨וֹת הַמִּזְבֵּ֤חַ סָבִיב֙ בְּאֶצְבָּע֔וֹ וַיְחַטֵּ֖א אֶת הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְאֶת הַדָּ֗ם יָצַק֙ אֶל יְס֣וֹד הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וַֽיְקַדְּשֵׁ֖הוּ לְכַפֵּ֥ר עָלָֽיו

verses.restored: He took all fat on inward parts, lobe of liver, two kidneys and their fat, and Moses turned them into smoke on altar.

familiar.text: And he took all the fat that was upon the inwards, and the caul above the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and Moses burned it upon the altar.

modern.text: Moses also took all the fat that was on the entrails, the lobe of the liver, and both kidneys and their fat, and burned it all on the altar.

original.text: וַיִּקַּ֗ח אֶֽת כָּל הַחֵלֶב֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל הַקֶּרֶב֒ וְאֵת֙ יֹתֶ֣רֶת הַכָּבֵ֔ד וְאֶת שְׁתֵּ֥י הַכְּלָיֹ֖ת וְאֶֽת חֶלְבְּהֶ֑ן וַיַּקְטֵ֥ר מֹשֶׁ֖ה הַמִּזְבֵּֽחָה

verses.restored: But bull, its skin, flesh, and dung he burned with fire outside camp, as YHWH commanded Moses.

familiar.text: But the bullock, and his hide, his flesh, and his dung, he burnt with fire without the camp; as the LORD commanded Moses.

modern.text: But the bull with its hide, flesh, and dung he burned outside the camp, as the LORD had commanded him. The Priests’ Burnt Offering

original.text: וְאֶת הַפָּ֤ר וְאֶת עֹרוֹ֙ וְאֶת בְּשָׂר֣וֹ וְאֶת פִּרְשׁ֔וֹ שָׂרַ֣ף בָּאֵ֔שׁ מִח֖וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה

verses.restored: He brought near ram of burnt offering, and Aaron and his sons laid hands on head of ram.

familiar.text: And he brought the ram for the burnt offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.

modern.text: Then Moses presented the ram for the burnt offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head.

original.text: וַיַּקְרֵ֕ב אֵ֖ת אֵ֣יל הָעֹלָ֑ה וַֽיִּסְמְכ֞וּ אַהֲרֹ֧ן וּבָנָ֛יו אֶת יְדֵיהֶ֖ם עַל רֹ֥אשׁ הָאָֽיִל

verses.restored: He slaughtered it, and Moses threw blood/life on altar all around.

familiar.text: And he killed it; and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about.

modern.text: Moses slaughtered the ram and sprinkled the blood on all sides of the altar.

original.text: וַיִּשְׁחָ֑ט וַיִּזְרֹ֨ק מֹשֶׁ֧ה אֶת הַדָּ֛ם עַל הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב

verses.restored: The ram he cut into its pieces, and Moses turned head, pieces, and fat into smoke.

familiar.text: And he cut the ram into pieces; and Moses burnt the head, and the pieces, and the fat.

modern.text: He cut the ram into pieces and burned the head, the pieces, and the fat.

original.text: וְאֶת הָאַ֔יִל נִתַּ֖ח לִנְתָחָ֑יו וַיַּקְטֵ֤ר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶת הָרֹ֔אשׁ וְאֶת הַנְּתָחִ֖ים וְאֶת הַפָּֽדֶר

verses.restored: Inward parts and legs he washed with water, and Moses turned all ram into smoke on altar. It was burnt offering for soothing scent, fire-offering to YHWH, as YHWH commanded Moses.

familiar.text: And he washed the inwards and the legs in water; and Moses burnt the whole ram upon the altar: it was a burnt sacrifice for a sweet savour, and an offering made by fire unto the LORD; as the LORD commanded Moses.

modern.text: He washed the entrails and legs with water and burned the entire ram on the altar as a burnt offering, a pleasing aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD, just as the LORD had commanded Moses. The Ram of Ordination (Exodus 29:10–30)

original.text: וְאֶת הַקֶּ֥רֶב וְאֶת הַכְּרָעַ֖יִם רָחַ֣ץ בַּמָּ֑יִם וַיַּקְטֵר֩ מֹשֶׁ֨ה אֶת כָּל הָאַ֜יִל הַמִּזְבֵּ֗חָה עֹלָ֨ה ה֤וּא לְרֵֽיחַ נִיחֹ֨חַ֙ אִשֶּׁ֥ה הוּא֙ לַיהוָ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה

verses.restored: He brought near second ram, ram of ordination/filling, and Aaron and his sons laid hands on head of ram.

familiar.text: And he brought the other ram, the ram of consecration: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.

modern.text: After that, Moses presented the other ram, the ram of ordination, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head.

original.text: וַיַּקְרֵב֙ אֶת הָאַ֣יִל הַשֵּׁנִ֔י אֵ֖יל הַמִּלֻּאִ֑ים וַֽיִּסְמְכ֞וּ אַהֲרֹ֧ן וּבָנָ֛יו אֶת יְדֵיהֶ֖ם עַל רֹ֥אשׁ הָאָֽיִל

verses.restored: He slaughtered it, and Moses took from its blood/life and put on lobe of Aaron's right ear, thumb of his right hand, and big toe of his right foot.

familiar.text: And he slew it; and Moses took of the blood of it, and put it upon the tip of Aaron’s right ear, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot.

modern.text: Moses slaughtered the ram and took some of its blood and put it on Aaron’s right earlobe, on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot.

original.text: וַיִּשְׁחָ֓ט וַיִּקַּ֤ח מֹשֶׁה֙ מִדָּמ֔וֹ וַיִּתֵּ֛ן עַל תְּנ֥וּךְ אֹֽזֶן אַהֲרֹ֖ן הַיְמָנִ֑ית וְעַל בֹּ֤הֶן יָדוֹ֙ הַיְמָנִ֔ית וְעַל בֹּ֥הֶן רַגְל֖וֹ הַיְמָנִֽית

verses.restored: He brought Aaron's sons near, and Moses put from blood/life on lobe of their right ear, thumb of their right hand, and big toe of their right foot; Moses threw blood/life on altar all around.

familiar.text: And he brought Aaron’s sons, and Moses put of the blood upon the tip of their right ear, and upon the thumbs of their right hands, and upon the great toes of their right feet: and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about.

modern.text: Moses also presented Aaron’s sons and put some of the blood on their right earlobes, on the thumbs of their right hands, and on the big toes of their right feet. Then he sprinkled the blood on all sides of the altar.

original.text: וַיַּקְרֵ֞ב אֶת בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֗ן וַיִּתֵּ֨ן מֹשֶׁ֤ה מִן הַדָּם֙ עַל תְּנ֤וּךְ אָזְנָם֙ הַיְמָנִ֔ית וְעַל בֹּ֤הֶן יָדָם֙ הַיְמָנִ֔ית וְעַל בֹּ֥הֶן רַגְלָ֖ם הַיְמָנִ֑ית וַיִּזְרֹ֨ק מֹשֶׁ֧ה אֶת הַדָּ֛ם עַל הַֽמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב

verses.restored: He took fat, fat tail, all fat on inward parts, lobe of liver, two kidneys and their fat, and right thigh.

familiar.text: And he took the fat, and the rump, and all the fat that was upon the inwards, and the caul above the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and the right shoulder:

modern.text: And Moses took the fat—the fat tail, all the fat that was on the entrails, the lobe of the liver, and both kidneys with their fat—as well as the right thigh.

original.text: וַיִּקַּ֞ח אֶת הַחֵ֣לֶב וְאֶת הָֽאַלְיָ֗ה וְאֶֽת כָּל הַחֵלֶב֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל הַקֶּרֶב֒ וְאֵת֙ יֹתֶ֣רֶת הַכָּבֵ֔ד וְאֶת שְׁתֵּ֥י הַכְּלָיֹ֖ת וְאֶֽת חֶלְבְּהֶ֑ן וְאֵ֖ת שׁ֥וֹק הַיָּמִֽין

verses.restored: From basket of unleavened bread that was before YHWH he took one unleavened cake, one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, and placed them on fat portions and right thigh.

familiar.text: And out of the basket of unleavened bread, that was before the LORD, he took one unleavened cake, and a cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, and put them on the fat, and upon the right shoulder:

modern.text: And from the basket of unleavened bread that was before the LORD, he took one cake of unleavened bread, one cake of bread made with oil, and one wafer, and he placed them on the fat portions and on the right thigh.

original.text: וּמִסַּ֨ל הַמַּצּ֜וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה לָ֠קַח חַלַּ֨ת מַצָּ֤ה אַחַת֙ וְֽחַלַּ֨ת לֶ֥חֶם שֶׁ֛מֶן אַחַ֖ת וְרָקִ֣יק אֶחָ֑ד וַיָּ֨שֶׂם֙ עַל הַ֣חֲלָבִ֔ים וְעַ֖ל שׁ֥וֹק הַיָּמִֽין

verses.restored: He put all on palms of Aaron and palms of his sons and waved them as wave offering before YHWH.

familiar.text: And he put all upon Aaron’s hands, and upon his sons’ hands, and waved them for a wave offering before the LORD.

modern.text: He put all these in the hands of Aaron and his sons and waved them before the LORD as a wave offering.

original.text: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן אֶת הַכֹּ֔ל עַ֚ל כַּפֵּ֣י אַהֲרֹ֔ן וְעַ֖ל כַּפֵּ֣י בָנָ֑יו וַיָּ֧נֶף אֹתָ֛ם תְּנוּפָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: Moses took them from their palms and turned them into smoke on altar upon burnt offering; they were ordination/filling offerings for soothing scent, fire-offering to YHWH.

familiar.text: And Moses took them from off their hands, and burnt them on the altar upon the burnt offering: they were consecrations for a sweet savour: it is an offering made by fire unto the LORD.

modern.text: Then Moses took these from their hands and burned them on the altar with the burnt offering. This was an ordination offering, a pleasing aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.

original.text: וַיִּקַּ֨ח מֹשֶׁ֤ה אֹתָם֙ מֵעַ֣ל כַּפֵּיהֶ֔ם וַיַּקְטֵ֥ר הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חָה עַל הָעֹלָ֑ה מִלֻּאִ֥ים הֵם֙ לְרֵ֣יחַ נִיחֹ֔חַ אִשֶּׁ֥ה ה֖וּא לַיהוָֽה

verses.restored: Moses took breast and waved it as wave offering before YHWH; from ram of ordination/filling it was Moses' portion, as YHWH commanded Moses.

familiar.text: And Moses took the breast, and waved it for a wave offering before the LORD: for of the ram of consecration it was Moses’ part; as the LORD commanded Moses.

modern.text: He also took the breast—Moses’ portion of the ram of ordination—and waved it before the LORD as a wave offering, as the LORD had commanded him.

original.text: וַיִּקַּ֤ח מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶת הֶ֣חָזֶ֔ה וַיְנִיפֵ֥הוּ תְנוּפָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה מֵאֵ֣יל הַמִּלֻּאִ֗ים לְמֹשֶׁ֤ה הָיָה֙ לְמָנָ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה

verses.restored: Moses took from anointing oil and from blood/life that was on altar and sprinkled on Aaron, on his garments, on his sons, and on garments of his sons with him; he sanctified Aaron, his garments, his sons, and garments of his sons with him.

familiar.text: And Moses took of the anointing oil, and of the blood which was upon the altar, and sprinkled it upon Aaron, and upon his garments, and upon his sons, and upon his sons’ garments with him; and sanctified Aaron, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons’ garments with him.

modern.text: Next, Moses took some of the anointing oil and some of the blood that was on the altar and sprinkled them on Aaron and his garments, and on his sons and their garments. So he consecrated Aaron and his garments, as well as Aaron’s sons and their garments.

original.text: וַיִּקַּ֨ח מֹשֶׁ֜ה מִשֶּׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֗ה וּמִן הַדָּם֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ֒ וַיַּ֤ז עַֽל אַהֲרֹן֙ עַל בְּגָדָ֔יו וְעַל בָּנָ֛יו וְעַל בִּגְדֵ֥י בָנָ֖יו אִתּ֑וֹ וַיְקַדֵּ֤שׁ אֶֽת אַהֲרֹן֙ אֶת בְּגָדָ֔יו וְאֶת בָּנָ֛יו וְאֶת בִּגְדֵ֥י בָנָ֖יו אִתּֽוֹ

verses.restored: Moses said to Aaron and his sons, Boil flesh at entrance of tent of meeting, and there eat it and bread in basket of ordination/filling offerings, as I commanded, saying, Aaron and his sons shall eat it.

familiar.text: And Moses said unto Aaron and to his sons, Boil the flesh at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and there eat it with the bread that is in the basket of consecrations, as I commanded, saying, Aaron and his sons shall eat it.

modern.text: And Moses said to Aaron and his sons, “Boil the meat at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and eat it there with the bread that is in the basket of ordination offerings, as I commanded, saying, ‘Aaron and his sons are to eat it.’

original.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶל אַהֲרֹ֣ן וְאֶל בָּנָ֗יו בַּשְּׁל֣וּ אֶת הַבָּשָׂר֮ פֶּ֣תַח אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵד֒ וְשָׁם֙ תֹּאכְל֣וּ אֹת֔וֹ וְאֶ֨ת הַלֶּ֔חֶם אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּסַ֣ל הַמִּלֻּאִ֑ים כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר צִוֵּ֨יתִי֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר אַהֲרֹ֥ן וּבָנָ֖יו יֹאכְלֻֽהוּ

verses.restored: What remains from flesh and bread you shall burn with fire.

familiar.text: And that which remaineth of the flesh and of the bread shall ye burn with fire.

modern.text: Then you must burn up the remainder of the meat and bread.

original.text: וְהַנּוֹתָ֥ר בַּבָּשָׂ֖ר וּבַלָּ֑חֶם בָּאֵ֖שׁ תִּשְׂרֹֽפוּ

verses.restored: From entrance of tent of meeting you shall not go out seven days, until day of completing days of your ordination/filling; for seven days he shall fill your hand.

familiar.text: And ye shall not go out of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation in seven days, until the days of your consecration be at an end: for seven days shall he consecrate you.

modern.text: You must not go outside the entrance to the Tent of Meeting for seven days, until the days of your ordination are complete; for it will take seven days to ordain you.

original.text: וּמִפֶּתַח֩ אֹ֨הֶל מוֹעֵ֜ד לֹ֤א תֵֽצְאוּ֙ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים עַ֚ד י֣וֹם מְלֹ֔את יְמֵ֖י מִלֻּאֵיכֶ֑ם כִּ֚י שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים יְמַלֵּ֖א אֶת יֶדְכֶֽם

verses.restored: As he has done this day, YHWH commanded to do, to make atonement/covering for you.

familiar.text: As he hath done this day, so the LORD hath commanded to do, to make an atonement for you.

modern.text: What has been done today has been commanded by the LORD in order to make atonement on your behalf.

original.text: כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה בַּיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה לַעֲשֹׂ֖ת לְכַפֵּ֥ר עֲלֵיכֶֽם

verses.restored: At entrance of tent of meeting you shall stay day and night seven days, and keep watch of YHWH's charge, so you do not die, for so I was commanded.

familiar.text: Therefore shall ye abide at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation day and night seven days, and keep the charge of the LORD, that ye die not: for so I am commanded.

modern.text: You must remain at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting day and night for seven days and keep the LORD’s charge so that you will not die, for this is what I have been commanded.”

original.text: וּפֶתַח֩ אֹ֨הֶל מוֹעֵ֜ד תֵּשְׁב֨וּ יוֹמָ֤ם וָלַ֨יְלָה֙ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֛ם אֶת מִשְׁמֶ֥רֶת יְהוָ֖ה וְלֹ֣א תָמ֑וּתוּ כִּי כֵ֖ן צֻוֵּֽיתִי

verses.restored: Aaron and his sons did all matters that YHWH commanded by hand of Moses.

familiar.text: So Aaron and his sons did all things which the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.

modern.text: So Aaron and his sons did everything the LORD had commanded through Moses.

original.text: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ אַהֲרֹ֖ן וּבָנָ֑יו אֵ֚ת כָּל הַדְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה בְּיַד מֹשֶֽׁה

translation_notes: Leviticus 8 narrates performance of Exodus 29 ordination instructions.
Ordination/filling-hand idiom is preserved to show installation into service.
Blood/life on ear, thumb, and toe marks hearing, doing, and walking in consecrated service.
Seven-day staying at tent entrance is ritual formation and boundary, not arbitrary confinement.
safety_note: Priestly ordination is accountable service, not status entitlement. Ritual blood/life symbolism should be handled with solemnity and not sensationalized.
